# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description | strip_newlines | strip }}

Students of a graduate course read one AI research paper per week and publish what they make of it: rewritten abstracts, critiques, redrawn figures, reimplementations, literature maps, follow-up ideas and social media posts. Each paper page collects everything written about that paper.

## Papers
{% assign papers = site.papers | sort: 'year' | reverse %}{% for p in papers %}
- [{{ p.title }}]({{ p.url | absolute_url }}): {% if p.tldr and p.tldr contains 'To be written' %}{{ p.authors }}, {{ p.year }}{% elsif p.tldr %}{{ p.tldr | strip_newlines | strip }}{% else %}{{ p.authors }}, {{ p.year }}{% endif %}{% if p.arxiv %} (arXiv {{ p.arxiv }}){% endif %}{% endfor %}

## Posts
{% for post in site.posts %}{% assign r = site.data.roles | where: 'id', post.role | first %}{% assign pp = site.papers | where: 'slug', post.paper | first %}
- [{{ post.title }}]({{ post.url | absolute_url }}): {% if post.description %}{{ post.description | strip_newlines }} {% endif %}({% if r %}{{ r.name }}{% endif %}{% if pp %}, on "{{ pp.title }}"{% endif %}, {{ post.date | date: '%Y-%m-%d' }}){% endfor %}
